options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Scenario Branching
Shuffle Buildings
options.doc:
Determines which buildings to shuffle.
Economy: Shuffle houses, TC, market, resource buildings, farms. Includes dock.
Tech: Shuffle blacksmith, university, monastery.
Military: Shuffle military buildings. Includes dock and castle.
Defense: Shuffle defensive buildings. Includes castle.
Unique: Shuffle unique buildings, if applicable civilizations are in the pool. Other options apply to these buildings, e.g. if economy isn't shuffled, neither is folwark.
Wonder: The wonder, the wonder, the... NO!
options.doc_fr:
Détermine les bâtiments à mélanger.
Economy: Maisons de shuffle, TC, marché, bâtiments de ressources, fermes. Y compris le quai.
Tech: Schuffle forgeron, université, monastère.
Military: Shuffle les bâtiments militaires. Comprend le quai et le château.
Defense: Shuffle bâtiments défensifs. Comprend le château.
Unique: Shuffle bâtiments uniques, si les civilisations applicables sont dans la piscine. D'autres options s'appliquent à ces bâtiments, p. ex. si l'économie n'est pas bousculée, il n'y a pas non plus de folwark.
Wonder: La merveille, la merveille, la...
